title: Context Length
description: Maximum prompt plus reply length in tokens. 0 uses the model limit. Rounded up to a power of two (minimum 512), then capped to the largest power of two within the model limit. Applies from the next model load.

title: NPU Power Mode
description: NPU power profile. Performance is the FLM default; choose a lower-power profile or Turbo when appropriate for the host. Applies from the next model load.

title: Prefill Chunk Length
description: Tokens processed per prompt-reading pass. 0 keeps the model default. Other values round up to a power of two, with a minimum of 512. This does not change the context limit. Applies from the next model load.

title: Prefix Cache Limit (MiB)
description: Maximum host memory used to reuse previously processed prompts on supported models. This is a limit, not a reservation. Applies from the next model load.

title: Prefix Cache Slots
description: Maximum number of saved prompt prefixes on supported models. 0 disables prefix caching. Applies from the next model load.

title: Prefix Cache Minimum Gain
description: Save a prefix only when it adds this many tokens beyond an existing cached prefix. 0 saves every eligible prompt; larger values reduce saves at the cost of more repeated prompt processing. Applies from the next model load.

title: FastFlowLM load timeout
description: Maximum time in seconds to load the selected checkpoint on the NPU.
